description: Moss green blotched with bark brown, dark veins branching in to one red knot at the middle. Filed with the blood stones.
lore: In a full bag you can find one without looking. Every hard piece is warm; this one is warm unevenly, a hot spot over the red knot at the middle, the way heat comes through a coat with somebody in it. Collectors mention that to each other exactly once, at the start, and not again.

Every one of these on a bench was cracked out of [[monsters/tree_stump|a Stumpling]] by a hand other than [[characters/646b922c|Sigrun's]]; her refusal is its own story. What her bench shows is the other half of it: she will set the stones once the cracking is done elsewhere — sets them better than anyone in the district — and she lifts each one from the tray with the long tongs she otherwise keeps for iron out of the fire.

An apprentice asked about the tongs once, it being a cold stone by iron's standards. It is warm in the middle, she said. They are all warm, said the apprentice, which is true. Not like this, she said, and got on with the setting, and the apprentice put the question away with the other things you do not ask Sigrun twice.
gm_notes: The tongs are the tell, never the text: a stone warm like a held hand is her husband's country, and she will not take one bare-handed. Explain them nowhere; the apprentice scene is as close as shipped prose gets.
